text:
Predicates:
GivenOnTV(x, y, z) ::: x is given out on y at z.
OnBachelor(x) ::: x is on the Bachelor.
PortraysLives(x, y) ::: x portrays the lives of y.
RealityTV(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
Premises:
∃x ∃y (Monday(x) ∧ Time(y, 8pm) ∧ GivenOnTV(roses, TV, y)) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀x (GivenOnTV(x, TV, y) → OnBachelor(x)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (OnBachelor(x) → PortraysLives(x, realPeople)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (PortraysLives(x, realPeople) → RealityTV(x)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTV(BreakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.
Conclusion:
¬(OnMonday(BreakingBad) ∧ Time(BreakingBad, 8pm)) ::: Breaking Bad is not on Monday at 8 pm.
